title: Configuration
description: A sentinel as the configuration an eval log records, and the stages it watches.

Tools that run a sentinel somewhere other than an eval, such as a scan that replays it over logs, use these to carry it between processes as its configuration and to tell which steps it reads. See [Configuration](../configuration.qmd) for the configuration's shape.
